# xpenser

> Open-source, self-hostable personal finance tracking with dashboards, reports, API keys, Telegram, and MCP access.

xpenser is an early personal finance app and Cleverbrush Framework reference implementation. It supports income and expense tracking, categories, vendors, multi-currency reporting, API keys, MCP tools, and Telegram workflows.

## Product Pages

- [xpenser homepage](https://xpenser.cleverbrush.com/): Self-hosted personal finance tracking overview.
- [Self-hosted personal finance tracker](https://xpenser.cleverbrush.com/self-hosted-personal-finance-tracker): Deployment and self-hosting angle.
- [Open-source expense tracker](https://xpenser.cleverbrush.com/open-source-expense-tracker): Expense, income, vendor, category, and report workflows.
- [Personal finance API and MCP access](https://xpenser.cleverbrush.com/personal-finance-api-mcp): API keys, typed client access, MCP tools, and agent workflows.

## Source and Docs

- [xpenser GitHub](https://github.com/cleverbrush/xpenser): MIT licensed source code.
- [Cleverbrush Framework docs](https://docs.cleverbrush.com): Framework documentation behind the app.
- [Cleverbrush Schema docs](https://schema.cleverbrush.com): Schema and contract tooling documentation.
